newsitem.title: DUBAI: Abu Dhabi inspection firm set up under offset.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi inspection firm set up under offset.

text.p: Abu-Dhabi's Al Mansoori Specialized Engineering and Texas-based Solex Environmental Services have set up a joint venture inspection services company as part of U.S. General Electric Co's offset obligation in the Gulf Arab state, the United Arab Emirates (UAE) Offsets Group (UOG) said on Tuesday.
The venture, Solex Robotics Service, will have a capitalisation of $2 million and provide inspection services for bulk storage tanks holding refined oil and chemical products.

"General Electric Aircraft Engines is working with Solex Environmental Services in connection with the UAE Offsets Group to support the formation of Solex Robotics Systems," a statement from the UAE Offsets Group said.
General Electric's aircraft division is competing to supply jet engines to the UAE airforce, the statement said.
UOG was launched in July 1990 when the UAE activated a plan to buy high-tech weapons worth billions of dollars.
The UAE requires companies it buys weapons from to invest part of the value of the contract in joint ventures with local investors as a way of diversifying the oil-dominated economy.
